description: Check an ApexMaps options object against what the library does with it: geo.map present and a built-in map id (or a URL / inline geometry), hex layouts only where one exists, a frameable geo.view.fit, geo.tiles with a url on a webMercator projection, known series types, arc from/to endpoints, line paths, bubble/marker coordinates or something to join on, hexbin point positions and aggregates (a hexbin has no joinBy), pixel shape / grid / lattice / spacing, [lon, lat] ordering, joinBy shape, null (not undefined) for missing values, known scale / projection / palette names, and boolean theme.tokens / theme.designSystem. Returns structured issues with stable rule ids, severity, path, and a fix when there is a one-shot remedy.

config.description: The ApexMaps options object to validate.

name: apexmaps_validate_config
title: Validate ApexMaps config
